model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and a coverage metric for multiple datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and displays values on a logarithmic scale from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at integer powers of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage,” also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.8. The first line, labeled “Llama-3B,” is solid blue and marked with circular markers. It begins at 0.36 at x=2⁰ and rises gradually to 0.78 at x=2⁸. The second line is represented by a dashed green marker in the shape of a triangle, labeled “Llama-3B + FT,” commencing at 0.35 at x=2⁰ and increasing to 0.78 at x=2⁸. The third line, labeled "Llama-1B," is represented by a solid green line and marked with triangular markers, starting at 0.33 at x = 2⁰ and increasing to 0.76 at x = 2⁸. The final line is a dashed light green marker in the shape of a triangle which is labeled “Llama-1B + FT,” starting at 0.33 at x=2⁰ and increasing to 0.77 at x=2⁸.
